 Job Description: 
 5K SIGN ON BONUS AT THE TIME OF HIRE AND REMAIN FOR 90 DAYS 
 
 Job Summary: The Data Visualization Developer provides A4R Basing & Logistics Analytics Data Environment (BLADE) Builder Development and seamless integration of Maven Smart Systems data, schema, and operational analytics. The Data Visualization Developer Utilizing Qlik Sense expertise to support the BLADE hosted on the DoW ADVANA Data Fabric, focusing on operational level (MAJCOM staff) and tactical-level (Wing and below) requirements gathering and development.
 
 Job Description: The A4R Blade Builder Developer works closely with business analysts, product owners, and key stakeholders to design, develop, and implement custom dashboards, visualizations, and reports within Qlik Sense. Responsibilities include:
 Core Dashboard & Analytics Development
 Designing, developing, and deploying custom dashboards, data visualizations, and reporting products in Qlik Sense to meet complex organizational requirements.
 Creating custom reporting solutions tailored for both operational and tactical audiences.
 Employing expert-level SQL to build and modify complex queries for multi‑source datasets.
 
 Maven Smart Systems (MSS) Integration & Support
 Supporting continued data engagement requirements related to Mavin Smart System integration within core COP/CIP environments.
 Integrating MSS data schemas and maintaining alignment with MSS COP, AIDP, and enterprise system architectures.
 Assisting in modernization of MSS-related workflows such as unified aircraft object schemas developed in the Maven environment.
 Enhancing MSS posture dashboards by combining automated BLADE data feeds with mission‑specific manual input options.
 Delivering interface and usability upgrades across MSS‑related portals to improve availability, readability, and operational execution.
 
 Enterprise Data Environment Interoperability
 Leveraging established BLADE standards, policies, and processes across NIPR, SIPR, and ADVANA environments to ensure interoperability.
 Supporting MSS, NATO C2, COP/CIP, and multi‑domain data integrations as emerging priorities evolve.
 
 Agile Collaboration
 Participating in Kanban/SCRUM sprints, performing sprint summaries, and attending weekly standups and retrospectives.
 Translating requirements into functional specifications, prototypes, and high‑impact analytic products.
 
 Training, Mentoring, & Governance
 Collaborating with the BLADE team for continuous improvement, receiving and providing mentoring across SQL, Qlik development, and MSS-related data practices.
 Submitting accurate BLADE requirements to the Basing and Logistics Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Steering Team (BLAAST).
 
 WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
 Minimum/General Experience: This position requires a minimum of five years of increasingly complex and progressive experience in performing systems analysis, development, and implementation for business sources. Requires experience with current technologies and, where required for the task, emerging technologies.
 Specialized Experience:
 MSS support including posture dashboards, schema alignment, interface enhancements, and COP/CIP integration.
 Expert-level Structured Query Language (SQL) skills, enabling the creation and modification of complex queries.
 Be proficient in gathering, analyzing, and translating requirements into functional specifications, prototypes, and working capabilities
 Experience with Databricks and iQuery data access/management tools.
 Preferred qualifications include Qlik Sense certifications (Business Analyst, Data Architect).
 Preferred experience includes Business Intelligence tools such as Tableau, Lumira, Power BI, Business Objects.
 
 Certifications:
 While not strictly mandated by DoW 8570.01-M, the following certifications are highly desired:
 Palantir Certifications (e.g. Data Engineer, Application Developer, AI Engineer, Foundry)
 Qlik Sense Certification (e.g. Business Analyst, Data Architect)
 
 Minimum Education: A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a curriculum or major field of study which provides substantial knowledge useful in managing large, complex AIS projects closely related to the work to be automated, and/or in a computer science, information system, a physical science, engineering or a mathematics - intensive discipline, or an applicable training certificate from an accredited training institution.
 
 Education and experience requirements may be substituted with:
 Master’s Degree (in subjects described above) with three years relevant experience OR
 No Degree and 11 years (nine directly related) experience.
 Clearance: Secret
 Germany TESA eligibility/certification required.

 Total Rewards at GDIT: 
Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most. 
 
 Our Identity Verification Process: 
As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.
